# Sharafdin Yusuf

> Personal site of Sharafdin Yusuf, self-taught and focused on AI research for the Somali language at Goobo Labs.

## Pages

- [About](https://sharafdin.com/): Biography, open-source projects, science, and mentorship
- [Milicsi](https://milicsi.sharafdin.com/): Writing in Somali

## Projects

- [Soplang](https://github.com/soplang/soplang): Somali programming language
- [nabadOS](https://github.com/sharafdin/nabadOS): Somali-localized Linux distribution
- [Somali Language Standard](https://github.com/goobolabs/somali-language-standard): Open standard for Somali orthography, grammar, terminology, and AI resources
- [SomNLP-Corpus](https://github.com/goobolabs/SomNLP-Corpus): Open Somali text corpus for NLP and LLM research
- [hanticoin-go](https://github.com/sharafdin/hanticoin-go): Blockchain core for Hanticoin
- [Memvid](https://github.com/memvid/memvid): Memory layer for AI agents
- [YoAuditor](https://github.com/sharafdin/yoauditor): LLM-powered code auditor in Rust
